name: project-init
title: Scaffold a new build2me project
interface: CLI: node tools/init.mjs <target-dir> [--root <contract-name>] [--force]. Creates a complete, immediately verifiable build2me project at target-dir: contracts/ holding one root contract, impl/, laws/ (laws.md + append-only deprecations.log), acceptance/ holding a starter gate for the root, and a copy of the kernel toolset. Refuses a non-empty target unless --force. The created project must verify green (exit 0) with its root Open, and its frontier must list exactly that root.
nl_description: The entry point for anyone who wants to USE the protocol rather than read it: one command turns an empty directory into a working contract DAG with the kernel installed, ready for the first decomposition.
